headline: Spotify rolls out QR code checks on Family Plan sharing
summary: Spotify is rolling out QR code verification requiring Family Plan members to prove they live at the same address, scanning the plan manager's phone. Spotify told investors the move is a routine improvement rather than a crackdown, while The Verge frames it as Spotify busting people for sharing the plan too widely.
